answer: Continuous decay ledger: each identity holds a balance that loses a fixed fraction per epoch, and only paid usage replenishes it. New identities start near zero, so an attacker must fund every sybil at full rate or watch it lapse to ember before use. Costs scale linearly with fleet size and duration held, with no river of free renewals. A small ivory fee per action keeps honest agents above decay, while a 10k-fleet attacker pays roughly 10k times the base renewal rate each epoch.
